uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-21924 flips node_architecture_validator to canonical by adding handle(request), which delegates to validate_architecture and then, only when the request carries a stack-shape snapshot, applies the stack command rules. The validate_architecture body and the rule helpers it uses are re-derived byte-identical base_ref<->HEAD by the ratchet from git. Equivalence for requests without a snapshot rests on that git-verbatim preservation plus the executed parity tests, which assert handle() returns exactly what validate_architecture returns over the scenario pool. The pool does not drive the stack-shape command branch; that branch is new in this change and is covered by tests/unit/docker/test_allowed_commands.py and tests/unit/validation/test_checker_stack_shape.py, not by a broad branch-coverage claim here.
